svg.title: Search and rescue worker — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as search and rescue worker, wearing a rescue jacket and a rescue helmet. Visible work cue: One clean climbing-rope bight with free ends sits beside an elongated locking carabiner. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a rescue helmet.
